entries.title: The Beast Inside

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release for capture; no console emulation route is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best route because it is the original full release with PC capture/settings flexibility. Later PlayStation, Xbox, and Switch releases make the game available on consoles, but there is no sourced platform-exclusive story or mode content that outweighs the PC route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy The Beast Inside on Steam and play the Windows PC build; check first if you want to adjust Unreal Engine 4 display behavior before capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: No separate remaster or content-complete edition is documented.
